is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles coluzzii collected in southern Benin (Page 1, 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) kdr-west mutation using PCR-PASA (Page 5, 7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (Page 7) provides detailed genotype counts (1014F/1014F, 1014L/1014F, 1014L/1014L) and allelic frequencies for An. gambiae (N=145) and An. coluzzii (N=581) across four agroecological zones.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected from breeding sites in southern Benin between April 2015 and October 2017 and reared to adults (Page 3, Table 1).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical study investigating vector species composition and Kdr resistance allele frequency in southern Benin.

sub_country_location.evidence: Table 1 lists 17 specific localities (e.g., Toffo, Klouékanmè, Dogbo, Cotonou, Porto-Novo) along with exact geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Larval collection took place from April 2015 to October 2017 (within a 3-year window), with individual collection dates specified per locality in Table 1.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Standard primary field collection of mosquito larvae across southern Benin.

supplement.evidence: All species identification and Kdr genotype data with exact sample sizes and coordinates are fully presented in Table 1 and Table 2 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the genetic structure and pyrethroid resistance allele frequency (Vgsc L1014F) in Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae s.s. populations collected across four agroecological zones in southern Benin between April 2015 and October 2017. Both species exhibited very high frequencies of the L1014F mutation (>85% across all zones).
